note: Alexey research line. Compacted rebuild of the sort_00/sort_01 systolic pipeline. Ships as sort_04; it does NOT beat sort_03 (the ring) and is kept for the record and for the measurement it produced.

variants.label: compacted 16-stage systolic pipeline
variants.architecture: same token protocol as sort_00/01 (SHIFT=10001 encoding, keep-max/forward-min stages, 16 HIGH flush tokens, RESET=-1). Stage room rebuilt from 14x20 to 8x9 by putting instructions on the vertical branch runs and sharing the reset/compare send cell. Dispatcher room removed entirely: the gate now ends a round by detecting RESET's sign instead of being told n, so no control pipe exists and every room has exactly one incoming and one outgoing pipe. Vertical serpentine puts stage 0 and stage 15 both on the array's top row so the loader and gate sit two cells away.

localValidation.stress: tests/test_alexey_sort_pipe.py: stage/loader/gate contracts verified in isolation, then 8 worst-shape and 60 randomized whole-program cases

comparison.vsSort03Ring: 3.8x worse score; 1.81x FASTER on ticks (2224.96 vs 4032.52) but 6.9x larger footprint (2500 vs 361)
comparison.whyUnreachable: 16 stage rooms at 8x9 are 1152 cells; a 25x25 bounding box holds 625, before the loader, the gate and 19 pipes
